title: ID0466473-DC/Si-D/NZ-[MP / R2 170001507]Charger in rebooting loop
description:
Reported behaviour/issue: Charger in rebooting loop.
Found CFast card had read errors, copied charger config and created new CFast card, re-installed in charger and all tested good.
Ticket can now be closed
